what: SMA jack body height: depth rod from the flat top of the gold jack body down to the board's top edge (each jack)
drives: top-wall inner face (the wall sits on the jack bodies)

what: Reference: exposed SMA thread with an antenna fully seated (jack body to the antenna nut face)
SMA jack centres from the board's left edge (front view): both jacks, jaws on the edge to the thread's centre
Standoff thread: try an M2.5 screw in a standoff's free end; if it is loose, try M3
Standoff length: board back face to the standoff's free end
Reference: hole pattern centre-to-centre, along the header and across
LNA button height: top of each white cap above the board front face
drives: lid clearance (10.5 to the inner face)

what: LNA button centres: from the left edge (both) and down from the top edge
drives: Ø 7.4 button holes in the lid

what: LED cluster round the airplane icon: centre from the left edge / top edge. Easier: photograph the board powered on, square-on, with a ruler beside it
Micro-USB receptacle centres from the left edge (ADS-B OUT, UAT OUT)
Micro-USB plug body: widest W × thickest T of the moulding (both leads)
Micro-USB plug body length: from where the metal shell enters the moulding to the end of the boot
drives: hood pocket depth (traps the plug), tie position

what: Micro-USB lead diameter, just behind the boot
Flange overall length, over both screw lobes
Flange screw centres: countersunk head to countersunk head, centre to centre
Flange width across the centre, square to F14
Flange plate thickness at a lobe edge
Raised centre disc diameter
Disc height above the flange plate (depth rod)
drives: the disc bears, the plate runs 0.3 clear

what: Cup height: cup rim flat on the table, up to the flange top face
Cup screw (M6 × 19): threaded length under the head. Fully threaded, or a plain shank first?
Reference: cup thread depth (19 − 6.66 left showing when bottomed)
Antenna length, nut face to tip (straight)
In the aircraft: window spot to the lanyard anchor (seat-belt anchor or cage), tape measure
